Introduction

Nam Yujin, formelly known as Eyedi is a South Korean singer. She debuted on July 19, 2016 with the single "Sign". In 2017, she participated on JTBC's reality competition show MIXNINE, ranking fifth overall for female contestants.

On July 10, 2022, the CEO of Bace Camp Studios stated that Eyedi was on indefinite hiatus. On February 19, 2024 she announced her departure from Bace Camp Studio after approximately four years of legal disputes and that she will continue her career under her birth name, Nam Yujin.
